meta.prior_knowledge_scope: contemporaneous B0 only; lagged coefficients come from the VAR pre-fit, which the inner DirectLiNGAM never sees

error_independence.note: LiNGAM assumes mutually independent errors; rejections mean the fitted model leaves dependence unexplained

assumption_notes: non-Gaussian residuals: only 0/31 VAR residual equations clear the non-Gaussianity thresholds (mean |excess kurtosis| 0.141, max negentropy 0.00862 nats). ICA cannot separate Gaussian sources, so the contemporaneous B0 is not identified
stationarity: ADF calls only 30/31 columns stationary
